title: Gitmap object record (one line of objects.ndjson)

order.description: Canonical dense z-rank (index in render order), NOT the raw source object id. Objects carry no stored id; objects.ndjson sorts by (partId, symbolId, geometry) and readers restore render order from `order`.

partId.description: References an inline manifest part id (default 'part_main').

coordinates.description: The object's coordinate list. For an area with holes this is the OUTER ring; interior rings go in `holes`.

holes.description: Interior rings (holes) of an area object, each a coordinate ring. Absent when the object has none. Ring boundaries are structural — no positional `hole` coord flag is stored.

text.description: Text content (text objects). Omitted when empty.

rotation.description: Object rotation in DEGREES, counter-clockwise, snapped to OCAD's 0.1° grid. Omitted when 0. (Area fill-pattern rotation lives in `pattern`, not here.)

hAlign.description: Text horizontal alignment. Omitted when default (left).

vAlign.description: Text vertical alignment. Omitted when default (baseline).

pattern.description: Per-object area-pattern override. rotation in degrees, snapped to 0.1°; dropped when all-default.

tag.description: Free-form per-object string payload (OCAD's object string — e.g. course/control codes, database links).

coord.description: A vertex tuple: [x, y] or [x, y, flags]. x,y in map units (0.01 mm), y-down (visual space) regardless of source. The optional third element is a semantic-flags object; a plain vertex is just [x, y]. Format-specific flag bytes (OCAD xFlags/yFlags, the OMap curve byte) are NOT stored — only the semantic flags below.

prefixItems.description: Semantic vertex flags; omitted entirely for a plain vertex. Each field is present only when true.

control.description: A Bézier control point. Control points come in pairs (cp1 then cp2); order recovers OCAD's 0x01/0x02.
